image_description: A close-up view of a car wheel mounted on a light blue vehicle. The wheel features a highly reflective chrome alloy rim with five split spokes and a central hub cap. A black rubber tire with visible tread patterns surrounds the rim. The background shows the car's fender and asphalt ground.

It is subtle but noticeable upon close inspection.
The texture of the ground is somewhat uniform and lacks the random variation of real gravel/asphalt, appearing slightly generated or overly smoothed.
